renderPrompt: Recast this existing stylized 3D animated shot using <Video 1> as the exact shot, with original camera depth, one wide pullback and the original scene timed as in the reference. The sole actor is the adult brown-haired officer in both images, wearing the same navy-and-gold coat and pale trousers. <Picture 1> shows source frame 855, a close dark prop with cool blue highlights diagonally in the upper left, the officer's near palm raised beside his face, and the original warm red scenery. <Picture 2> is source frame 877 with pullback to a wider standing composition, the same dark foreground prop in soft focus, and the officer further right with a sideways grin. Between them preserve how the original palm and sleeve move through the frame and how the foreground prop travels, blurs and reflects the source light. Keep the original framing, reflection and dark silhouette, the dim room and red lamp, walls and furniture. Maintain the image identity all the way through. review.observations: 逐帧对照原片第 855–877 帧两页。画面为神隐黑炎，保留左侧红梁、壁挂日历和前景道具。原片第 858 帧前后手已向前扫，道具随身位落到较平角度；候选前约 11 帧停在手靠脸的起始姿态，之后突然进入拉远的双手构图，遗漏动作中间态。后段一轮或多轮短闪明显漏位，末两处强闪尤其缺失。退回。
